subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw support per-session model selection from the Wear Home screen and retire the separate Wear Agent and Session pages, with model controls unavailable against older paired Phone builds?
rationale: The implementation is capability-gated and proof-positive, but it deliberately changes a user-facing Wear navigation model and extends the paired-device protocol; that acceptance is product and upgrade-policy judgment rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
options.body: Merge the capability-gated design and treat the three-control Home surface as the supported Wear context workflow.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Retain Agent and Session pages and limit this PR to an additive Home shortcut if preserving the existing navigation is preferred.

options.title: Pause for paired-upgrade policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers specify the expected old-Phone/new-Watch and new-Phone/old-Watch support commitment.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
recommendation.body: Merge the capability-gated design and treat the three-control Home surface as the supported Wear context workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who also authored the branch’s Wear state and protocol hardening commits.
